_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 2,152 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 215 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Lowe's own FY2017 10-K says 'We face growing competition from online and omni-channel retailers who have a similar product or service offering. Customers are increasingly able to quickly comparison shop and determine real-time product availability and price using digital tools.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'For purchases made on Lowes.com, customers may pick up their purchase in-store, have their purchase delivered from a store, or have their purchase parcel shipped.'. The stock trades at 18.3x FY18E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Lowe's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 2,152 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 215 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.22x; +22% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.85; conservative 2yr +12%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -18.8%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.1%/yr (FY18 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.8%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2018-07-13) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.22x (45.8% downside to Bear $54 / +37.6% upside to Bull $137) | Adj composite 1.80 vs market 2.65: gap -0.85 [OVERVALUED] | +22% above the EPP floor $82 (15x FY18E $5.45) | Conservative 2-yr case: +12.1% total (+6.1%/yr) | At 18.3x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $132 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps +0.6% in Q1 FY18, forward sales +5% (FY18 sales guide); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
